title: CreateCouponModal may have same /api/collections/ URL bug
body: src/ui/admin/Coupons/CreateCouponModal/index.tsx:105 fetches from '/api/collections/coupons' which may also return 404. The same fix pattern should be applied — change to '/api/coupons'.
rationale: Same root cause pattern as the transactions bug — Payload REST API uses /api/{slug} not /api/collections/{slug}
